name: Int.decLe

source.code:
/-- Decides whether `a ≤ b`.

  ```
  #eval ¬ ( (7 : Int) ≤ (0 : Int) ) -- true
  #eval (0 : Int) ≤ (0 : Int) -- true
  #eval (7 : Int) ≤ (10 : Int) -- true
  ```

  Implemented by efficient native code. -/
@[extern "lean_int_dec_le"]
instance decLe (a b : @& Int) : Decidable (a ≤ b) :=
  decNonneg _
